title: DATESBETWEEN only returns dates the Date table has
query: EVALUATE DATESBETWEEN ( 'Date'[Date], DATE ( 2022, 6, 1 ), DATE ( 2023, 1, 3 ) ) ORDER BY 'Date'[Date]

source.quote: A date lower than the minimum makes DATESBETWEEN start
source.supports: the example starts before the first date of the table and returns dates from the first date on

source.quote: The result includes only dates that exist in the Dates column.

derivation: The start, 2022-06-01, is before the first date of the table (2023-01-01), so the result is January 1 to 3, 2023.
